question.html:
a

In a “loop-the-loop” toy, a car of mass 0.12 kg is released from rest. The initial position of the car is 45 cm above level ground. The radius of the circular loop is 15 cm. The car reaches the top of the loop at position P. Frictional and air resistance forces are negligible.

a.i Show that the speed of the car at P is 1.7 m s−1. [2]

a.ii Determine the normal force exerted by the loop on the car at P. [3]

a.iii State why the car stays in contact with the loop. [1]

b

At point A the car collides with a block of mass 0.18 kg and sticks to it. After the collision, the car and the block move together with speed 1.2 m s−1.

b.i Calculate the speed of the car just before it collides with the block. [2]

b.ii The surface from A to B is rough and the combined car and block come to rest at B. The distance AB is 0.20 m. Determine the rate of change of momentum of the combined car and block from A to B. [3]

b.iii Calculate the dynamic coefficient of friction between the rough surface and the combined car and block. [2]
